scope: This is a terrain-selection guide for complete electric hobby RC cars in their documented configuration. It helps you choose a venue or vehicle category, rather than prescribe gearing changes, battery upgrades, water operation or a maximum obstacle size. Examples identify exact complete vehicles already reviewed on RC Car King. The decision process is editorial guidance grounded in manufacturer documentation, not a physical comparison test.
notes: Intent differs from previous steering-control guide: venue selection and surface/load matching.
Manufacturer facts distinguished from editorial category fit and venue-assessment sequence.
No universal grass height, clearance threshold, water procedure, gearing or battery upgrade prescribed.
Current TRX-4 Sport manual wet-operation LiPo restriction is explicitly preserved in FAQ.
No direct buying links, new ASINs or product ratings; previously verified complete-vehicle reviews linked for context.
Official gray 82224-4 studio photograph visually inspected; existing launch manifest provenance reused.
Original accessible four-question diagram explains clearance, traction, load and space.
